Title: Retrieve paginated orders scheduled for delivery today
Preconditions: A shop exists with shopId 1 and has at least one order with delivery date set to today's date
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/orders/today with query parameters shopId=1, page=0, and limit=10.

Test Data: shopId=1, page=0, limit=10
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with status 'success', message 'Today's delivery orders fetched successfully', meta pagination details, and data content containing the list of orders scheduled for today.

Title: Retrieve paginated overdue delivery orders for a shop
Preconditions: A shop exists with shopId 1 and has orders with delivery dates prior to today that are not in READY_FOR_DELIVERY status
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/orders/overdue with query parameters shopId=1, page=0, and limit=10.

Test Data: shopId=1, page=0, limit=10
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with status 'success', message 'Overdue delivery orders fetched successfully', meta pagination metadata, and data array containing overdue orders excluding those ready for delivery.

Title: Retrieve paginated orders created within the current month
Preconditions: A shop exists with shopId 1 and has orders recorded within the start and end dates of the current calendar month
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/orders/monthly with query parameters shopId=1, page=0, and limit=10.

Test Data: shopId=1, page=0, limit=10
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with status 'success', message 'Monthly orders fetched successfully', meta containing total elements and pages, and data array listing the orders for the current month.

Title: Retrieve paginated orders created on a specific date
Preconditions: A shop exists with shopId 1 and has orders placed on the specified order date
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/orders/new with query parameters shopId=1, orderDate=2026-03-30, page=0, and limit=10.

Test Data: shopId=1, orderDate=2026-03-30, page=0, limit=10
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with status 'success', message 'Orders fetched successfully for the date: 2026-03-30', and data array containing orders placed on that specified date.

Title: Attempt to fetch today's delivery orders without providing the required shop ID parameter
Preconditions: The backend service is running and accessible.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/orders/today without providing any query parameters.

Test Data: URL: /api/dashboard/orders/today
Expected Result: The system rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request, indicating that the required query parameter 'shopId' is missing.

Title: Attempt to fetch overdue delivery orders with a non-numeric shop ID parameter
Preconditions: The backend service is running and accessible.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/orders/overdue with a non-numeric shopId parameter value.

Test Data: URL: /api/dashboard/orders/overdue?shopId=invalid_shop
Expected Result: The system rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request, indicating that 'shopId' must be a valid numeric identifier.

Title: Attempt to fetch new dashboard orders using an invalid date format for orderDate
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists in the system.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/orders/new with shopId parameter set to 1 and orderDate formatted as DD-MM-YYYY instead of ISO format.

Test Data: URL: /api/dashboard/orders/new?shopId=1&orderDate=25-12-2023
Expected Result: The system rejects the request with HTTP 400 Bad Request, indicating that 'orderDate' must be in a valid ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD).

Title: Verify monthly orders endpoint includes orders placed on the exact start (1st day) and end (last day) of the current month, but excludes orders from adjacent months
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists. Three orders exist for shop ID 1: Order A placed on the last day of the previous month, Order B placed on the 1st day of the current month, and Order C placed on the last day of the current month.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/orders/monthly with query parameter shopId=1&page=0&limit=10.

Test Data: shopId=1, page=0, limit=10
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 OK with status 'success'. The returned data contains exactly 2 orders (Order B and Order C) with totalElements set to 2 in metaData. Order A from the previous month is not included in the response.

Title: Verify overdue orders endpoint includes orders with delivery date of yesterday but excludes orders with delivery date of today
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 exists. Order 101 has delivery date set to yesterday (1 day before today) and status MEASUREMENT_DONE. Order 102 has delivery date set to today and status MEASUREMENT_DONE.
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/dashboard/orders/overdue with query parameter shopId=1&page=0&limit=10.

Test Data: shopId=1, page=0, limit=10
Expected Result: HTTP status code 200 OK with status 'success'. The returned page contains Order 101 (delivery date yesterday), but does not contain Order 102 (delivery date today), confirming the strictly-before-today boundary.
